items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: I've known Horace. I think in Chicago.

ctx.x: Where did you know him, though?
I've known Horace. I think in Chicago.

Mm-hmm. I know he recorded with Charlie Roll Morton up there in Chicago, so I figured he's got to have been around there. Oh, and he played on the riverboat with Willie Humphrey in Dewey Jackson's band, too.
